# Powerbank Radar

> A free map of power bank rental stations from every operator: 4,981 stations from 17 operators in 8 countries, with prices, opening hours and live availability. Updated daily (last update 2026-11-20). Independent, not affiliated with the operators.

## Main pages

- [Map](https://www.powerbankradar.com/): find the nearest power bank rental station
- [FAQ](https://www.powerbankradar.com/faq/): how power bank rental works, prices, returns
- [Operators](https://www.powerbankradar.com/operators/): every operator with its countries and station count
- [About](https://www.powerbankradar.com/about/): where the data comes from
